verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a mobile app for repository collaboration: pull request review, issue triage, notifications and Copilot agent tasks. It is not a terminal or SSH client, so grouping terminal sessions and broadcasting commands is a category error for this product type. The GitHub CLI and Copilot CLI items describe separate terminal tools, not capabilities of GitHub Mobile, so they do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can group multiple terminal sessions together and broadcast the same command to all of them
